component.name: GCode EditSim
component.summary: Edit CNC G-code programs and see their toolpath in 3D

description.p: GCode EditSim is a G-code editor and backplotter for CNC milling. Open a program, see its toolpath in 3D beside the text, click a line to see its moves or click a move to find its line, and watch the toolpath update as you edit.
This early version reads Fanuc milling programs on a 3-axis mill, with user-editable machine definitions. It reports what it does not simulate yet instead of drawing it wrongly.
GCode EditSim is a visualization aid, not a safety verification tool. Always verify programs independently before running them on a machine.
First packaged preview: editor, 3D toolpath, line and toolpath sync, diagnostics in the editor.
